newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Shokubai to market dioxin dissolving plants.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Shokubai to market dioxin dissolving plants.

text.p: Nippon Shokubai Co Ltd said on Monday that it had developed and would start selling catalysts and facilities which it said could dissolve over 99 percent of the harmful dioxin emissions from garbage incineration plants.

A company official told Reuters that the leading Japanese manufacturer of chemical catalysts was aiming for annual sales of three billion yen in the next three years and five billion yen in the next five years for the new products.
The products, which can be used at existing garbage incineration plants, will be sold to local governments as well as to bodies in charge of industry waste in Japan.
Dioxin is a highly toxic by-product of some industrial processes and is known to cause a wide range of diseases, including cancer.
